(1) the euro area's political integration is still too low to safeguard the cohesion of the monetary union; (2) the euro area should move beyond the status quo of a half way political integration to a more advanced level; (3) the main challenge for the euro area's further political integration is to achieve a higher level of market-preserving fiscal federalism; and (4) this requires the euro area's institutional framework to be adjusted to better safeguard the single market, the integrity of
